propositions: rebar comment accepts flag-like tokens (--body-file, --body) as positional body arguments and stores the literal flag string as the comment instead of rejecting the invocation
the command exits with code 0 and produces no error message when a flag-looking body is stored, making the silent data loss undetectable without reading comment content
